//: Redirects are evaluated at the edge BEFORE the filesystem and before the SPA rewrite, so these are real 301s with a Location header. A client-side <Navigate> is not a redirect to a crawler — it answers 200 with the old URL's content and Google keeps the old URL as a duplicate.

redirects.//: /help/getting-started was the per-venue setup guide, and it is indexed. There are now three of those guides, one per venue, so the honest replacement for a request that did not name a venue is the venue index — not an arbitrary one of the three.

Listed before the /docs/:slug rule, which matches in order. Without it this would 301 to /help/getting-started and then 301 again to /exchanges — a two-hop chain for a URL that has one correct destination.
/docs/:slug used to drop the slug and land everything on /help. Keep the slug: /docs/kill-switch is a request for /help/kill-switch.
